notes.title: Live HoloFist level building!
notes.content:
Greetings, Fisters!

Ever wanted to see how a HoloFist level is built? Well now you can!, with tihs handy dandy livestream!

notes.title: 🔴 LIVE FISTING: an inside look [Oct 8th, 9pm GMT]
notes.content:
[i][b]Greetings, Fisters![/b][/i]

[i]Join us this Thursday for an inside look at HoloFist! An adventure set on the island of Fistpopia, a place where nobody thinks that word means what you think it means.[/i]

[b]Are you ready to:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34877716/3d95180784af52a5cb1f04498c7720ab3924b28a.png[/img]
[b]FIST:[/b][i] your way through two different types of turn-based battle - Fister duels, and wild encounters? Command your HoloBuddies to fight for your love against Enemy fisters, wild Buddies, or haywire killer robots![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34877716/009161f1355b9128d72b85fb1906e127b610b6b7.png[/img]
[b]FEED: [/b][i]your buddies copious amounts of junk food in order to help them grow strong? Including Bricks? Buckets of metal? Doughnuts?! Everything is game when your pets are made from light energy!
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34877716/96b759b4138601808bfdf374cb39172b545e52f8.png[/img]
[b]READ: [/b][i]through comic-book-like story scenes!? using speech bubbles makes something look like a comic, right? ...right?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34877716/734c07709aaee4b90cdd74e2ee444ae78aef7789.png[/img]
[b]DIE:[/b] [i]a few times trying to figure out how this "totally original" battle system works? Well I’m glad to hear it![/i]

If you said yes to any of the above, and we know you DID, then slide on your best mechanical gauntlet and join us this thursday for live gameplay, and thick and fast AMA action.
